original.target_description: Original study located; direct-appeal and complete-plea behavioral predictors of veracity, with unresolved assigned predictor/test.

notes: Both assigned rows give only the same broad description, study 1, and p.7; neither identifies a predictor, complete plea versus direct appeal, or separate versus multiple-predictor test. PDF page 7 (printed p.475) discusses multiple cues. No row-to-test correspondence can be established without guessing. Source title and DOI match the original reference. Rendered PDF pages 6 and 7 inspected. Candidate multiple-cue direct-appeal model: printed p.474 Table 4 gives beta-labelled logistic regression coefficients (standardization is not established): upper face surprise 2.52, Wald chi-square 6.90, OR 12.49; lower face happiness 1.56, Wald chi-square 3.31, OR 4.76; tentative words 0.14, Wald chi-square 6.13, OR 1.15; word count −0.04, Wald chi-square 4.37, OR 0.96. Table footnotes give p = .06 for lower face happiness and p ≤ .05 for the other three coefficients. The prose separately states ps < .05 for those three; these bounds are retained as distinct reports. Full-model chi-square(4, N = 52) = 31.58, p < .001 is an omnibus test, not any coefficient test. Candidate analytic N = 52 is explicitly printed for this direct-appeal model; the units are individual pleaders, not video frames. Only 52 of the 78 complete pleas include a direct appeal (p.471; p.473). This is a model/sample restriction; no additional model-specific exclusion is reported here. N is retained only as a candidate because the assigned critical test is unresolved. No N arithmetic or effect conversion performed. Other printed beta-labelled candidates: separate direct-appeal models p.473, upper face surprise 1.75, Wald chi-square 7.52, p < .05, OR 5.73; lower face happiness 1.20, Wald chi-square 3.91, p < .05, OR 3.33. Complete-plea models p.472: lower-face disgust 1.23, Wald chi-square 5.24, p < .05, OR 3.43; upper-face sadness −1.01, Wald chi-square 4.53, p < .05, OR 0.36; lower-face sadness −1.34, Wald chi-square 6.61, p < .05, OR 0.26. Complete-plea sample is 78 individuals, but this does not establish the target-specific analytic N. No evidence identifies these coefficients as standardized betas. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
